# Reply Sprint

The replies your posts got, each with a ready-to-send draft.

Use for answering the replies and mentions waiting on their posts. Not for one reply to a post they link.

**The user might say:** "Show the recent replies to my posts that deserve an answer and draft a reply for each. I will send them myself."

## Steps

1. Replies to their posts they haven't answered.
   ```sh
   xholic mentions list --kind REPLIES --hide-replied
   ```
2. Context for a reply when you need it.
   ```sh
   xholic posts conversation --tweet-id <id>
   ```
3. Write a specific reply to each yourself, in their voice.
4. The user posts or sends these on X themselves. Never say anything was posted.
